---
title: "Simulation study (RoLLR / S-RoLLR)"
output: html_document
---

Twelve data-generating mechanisms (Section 4).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))
```

```{r run}
# Cases 1-8 and 10-12 share the base setting (n = 800, p = 30, |I| = 20). Case 9
# is the small-sample high-dimensional heavy-tail setting (n = 300, p = 700, so
# p > n) that showcases S-RoLLR's small-sample robustness.
grid <- rbind(
  expand.grid(scenario = setdiff(ALL_SCENARIOS, "Case9: HighDim HeavyTail"),
              n = 800, p = 30, p_relevant = 20, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(scenario = "Case9: HighDim HeavyTail",
             n = 300, p = 700, p_relevant = 20, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
)
n_reps    <- 300
base_seed <- 1031

jobs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i)
  data.frame(grid[i, ], rep = seq_len(n_reps),
             seed = base_seed + (i - 1) * n_reps + seq_len(n_reps))))

FORCE_RERUN <- FALSE

RESULT_FILE <- here::here("results", "simulation_results.rds")
dir.create(dirname(RESULT_FILE), showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!FORCE_RERUN && file.exists(RESULT_FILE)) {

results <- readRDS(RESULT_FILE)

} else {

cl <- makeCluster(max(1, detectCores() - 1)); registerDoParallel(cl)

cpp_exports <- c("d_tpsc_cpp", "tpsc_nll_cpp", "tpsc_transform_cpp",
                 "tpsc_rowloglik_cpp")

results <- foreach(k = seq_len(nrow(jobs)), .combine = "rbind",
                   .packages = c("Rcpp","glmnet","e1071","randomForest",
                                 "lightgbm","mclust","pROC","MASS","Matrix"),
                   .noexport = cpp_exports,
                   .errorhandling = "pass") %dopar% {
  source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))
  j <- jobs[k, ]; set.seed(j$seed)
  d <- generate_data(j$scenario, j$n, j$p, j$p_relevant)
  X <- d$X; colnames(X) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(X)))
  sig <- paste0("V", seq_len(d$n_signal))            # true informative features
  idx <- sample(nrow(X), floor(0.7 * nrow(X)))
  out <- run_all_models(X[idx, ], d$y[idx], X[-idx, ], d$y[-idx],
                        signal_names = sig, tune = TRUE)
  cbind(scenario = j$scenario, repetition = j$rep, out)
}

stopCluster(cl); registerDoSEQ()
saveRDS(results, RESULT_FILE)

}
```

```{r summarise}
# Order the rows by Case number. ALL_SCENARIOS is already in natural order, so it doubles as the factor-level order for both tables.
results <- results %>%
  mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = ALL_SCENARIOS),
         model    = factor(model,    levels = MODEL_ORDER))

# Classification performance + timing
perf <- results %>%
  group_by(scenario, model) %>%
  summarise(auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE), acc = mean(acc, na.rm = TRUE),
            f1 = mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_seconds = median(seconds, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
print(perf, n = Inf)

# Selection accuracy (only L1-RL and S-RoLLR do intrinsic selection)
selection <- results %>%
  filter(model %in% c("S-RoLLR", "L1-RL")) %>%
  group_by(scenario, model) %>%
  summarise(mean_n_selected = mean(n_selected, na.rm = TRUE),
            TPR = mean(sel_tpr, na.rm = TRUE),
            FPR = mean(sel_fpr, na.rm = TRUE),
            sel_F1 = mean(sel_f1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
print(selection, n = Inf)
```

Note on interpretation: SVM, RF, LightGBM, GMM-NB, MOKE and RoLLR do not perform intrinsic hard variable selection, so selection TPR/FPR are reported only for the two L1-based methods. Timing is reported for all.
